questions.stem: What does ISO 11179 provide guidelines for?
options: The representation and management of metadata describing data and information resources
The codes used to identify countries and territories
The encryption of data in transit
questions.explanation: ISO 11179 is an international standard providing guidelines for the representation and management of metadata for describing data and information resources.

questions.stem: What is metadata, as referenced by ISO 11179?
options: Data about data, describing the characteristics, properties and context of data
Data stored in a cloud service
questions.explanation: Metadata is data about data: it describes the characteristics, properties and context of data, helping users understand what the data is and how it can be used.

questions.stem: What does ISO 11179 define as the basic building blocks of data?
questions.explanation: ISO 11179 defines the concept of data elements, the basic building blocks of data, each with associated metadata such as name, definition and data type.

questions.stem: What does the representation concept of ISO 11179 cover?
options: How to back up a database
How to assign three-letter codes to countries
How to define names, data types and relationships between data elements
questions.explanation: Representation provides guidelines for representing data elements, including how to define names, data types and relationships between them.

questions.stem: What does ISO 11179 encourage through registration?
options: Registering software licences with the vendor
Registering servers in a hardware inventory
Registering data elements in a central repository to promote consistency and reusability
questions.explanation: ISO 11179 encourages the registration of data elements in a central repository, promoting consistency and reusability across an organisation.

By requiring all systems to use the same database vendor
By converting all data to a single file format
By removing metadata from shared data
By restricting data to one department
questions.explanation: By standardising metadata, ISO 11179 promotes interoperability, allowing different systems and organisations to share and integrate data more effectively.

questions.stem: How does ISO 11179 contribute to data quality?
options: By automatically correcting spelling mistakes in records
By improving metadata so users can understand and trust the information they work with
By enforcing a maximum table size
By limiting who can insert rows
questions.explanation: Improved metadata leads to better data quality, as users can understand and trust the information they are working with.

questions.stem: In the library analogy for ISO 11179, what does the card for each book represent?
options: The metadata describing a data element
questions.explanation: In the analogy each book is a data element and its card is the metadata telling you the title, author and other details; ISO 11179 is a standard way to write and organise those cards.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a benefit of ISO 11179?
options: All of these are listed benefits
questions.explanation: The benefits listed are interoperability, consistency and data quality; bank capital requirements belong to the Basel standards, not ISO 11179.

questions.stem: What kind of metadata is associated with each data element under ISO 11179?
options: Its name, definition and data type
questions.explanation: Each data element has associated metadata such as its name, definition and data type.
